title: Databases
empty: No databases in this environment yet.
passwordNote: Passwords are generated for you and stored encrypted. You can reveal them on the database page.

validation.identifier: Use lowercase letters, digits and underscores, starting with a letter.

connection.title: Connection
connection.description: Applications in FerroDock reach the database by this host name on the internal network. It is not reachable from the internet unless you publish a port.
connection.hidden: Passwords are hidden. Revealing them is recorded in the audit log.

activity.title: Activity
activity.notRunning: The database is not running. Start or redeploy it to see its output.

external.title: Public access
external.description: Publish the database on a server port to connect from your computer or another server. The container is recreated when this changes.
external.exposed: Anyone who can reach port {{port}} on this server can try to log in. Limit access with a firewall.

delete.title: Delete database
delete.description: Removes the container. The data volume is kept unless you choose to delete it too.

backups.title: Backups
backups.description: Encrypted dumps on a schedule or on demand. Restoring replaces the current contents of the database.

limits.title: Resource limits
limits.description: Cap how much memory and CPU the database may use so it cannot starve other services. Leave a field empty for no limit. Swap is turned off when memory is limited, so a database that needs more memory is stopped instead of slowing the server down. The container is recreated when the limits change.
limits.memoryInvalid: Use at least {{min}} MiB, or leave it empty.
limits.cpusInvalid: Use between {{min}} and {{max}} cores, or leave it empty.
